note: The shared Gills kit's library sets (biomes/gills/PLAN.md section 15; delivered 2026-11-03), packed once here and read as a second pack by each host station that draws the Gills (station.json "packs": ["biomes/gills"]; xanadu's station gills reads them as KMAT.packed('gills', <family>)), so the host kit's other pages keep their bytes. Tintable sets are grey detail maps (keep 0) the country's dress colours; full-colour sets keep their hue. mineral.crust.ferromanganese (the Red collar) is in the library but not packed: no page draws the Red country yet. Run python3 tools/textures/pack.py biomes/gills after a change, and rebuild every station that lists the pack.

pipe.lamina.note: the pipe wall's daily couplets: a grey detail map (mean 0.5) the lamina shader multiplies into KSTRATA.laminaShade's colour, so the procedural beds and the thin years stay and the couplets show close up; scale is metres of pipe height per tile

collar.note: the White collar (Qolar): the brucite crust in its own colour, under the dress's collar tint that the breath brightens

fringe.note: the breath fringe: one tuft of the six-cell sheet, knob at the mouth, streaming along the card's length; grey (keep 0) so the dress's fringe colour colours it

turf.note: the breath meadow's limed turf round each dew mat (GILLS.life's turf records): one clump of the eight-cell sheet, crossed quads, its own colour
